FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Comprehension.

2. The French word for “book” is: (1 mark)
   A. porte
   B. livre
   C. chaise
   D. fenêtre

3. When practising Reading for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Comprehension.

4. “Bonjour” is used to say: (1 mark)
   A. Good morning / hello
   B. Excuse me
   C. Thank you
   D. Good night only

5. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.

6. When practising Grammar, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Grammar.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Grammar.

7. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.

8. When practising Reading for Vocabulary, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Vocabulary.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Vocabulary.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Vocabulary.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Vocabulary.

9. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Listening for Information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Listening for Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Listening for Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Interactive Speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Vocabulary and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
